name: Whatever this is...
description: A double pendulum with each mass attached to a different wall by a spring.
coordinates: Angle of the first link from vertically downward.
Angle of the second link from vertically downward, not relative to the first.
assumptions: Massless rigid links, point masses, and massless ideal springs that may stretch or compress.
Frictionless pivots; no damping or collisions.
Fixed anchors lie outside both masses’ reach; springs never have zero length.

references.title: UC Berkeley: double pendulum kinematics and energies

referenceNote: The combined two-anchor model is our synthesis of standard double-pendulum and Hooke-law models. These sources do not publish this exact combined example.
